assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has a known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias
The arrhythmias may be contributing to embolic events
The service addresses the clinical concern of detecting arrhythmias underlying the embolic events tied to the documented ischemic history
